```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Helper: load required packages safely and fail with a clear message
load_required_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The following required packages are not installed: ",
        paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))
}

required_packages <- c(
  # Data handling

  "data.table",

  # Visualization
  "ggpubr",
  "ggfixest",
  "grid",
  "gridExtra",
  "forestploter",
  "DiagrammeR",

  "survminer",
  "cmprsk",

  # Tables
  "table1",
  "flextable",

)

load_required_packages(required_packages)
```

## Bootstrap analyses

```{r, warning=FALSE, message = TRUE, eval = run_bootstraps}
# ==========================================================
# Heterogeneity bootstrap helper functions.
# ==========================================================

cutoff <- 0

# ---------- weighted quantile ----------
wtd_quantile <- function(x, w, probs) {
  if (!length(w) || sum(w, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(probs)))
  o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  sapply(probs, function(p) x[which.max(cw >= p)])
}

# ---------- fast base preparation ----------
# Provide: id, x, side, hz, y, g (stratum)
prepare_base_gender <- function(dat, id_var, strata_var, cutoff = 0) {
  tibble(
    id   = dat[[id_var]],
    x    = dat$running_var_days,
    side = ifelse(dat$running_var_days < cutoff, "L", "R"),
    hz   = dat$hz_vacc,
    y    = dat$dementia,
    g    = dat[[strata_var]]
  )
}

# ---------- m-out-of-n resample by side using row indices ----------
resample_idx_by_side <- function(base, rho = 0.95) {
  iL <- which(base$side == "L")
  iR <- which(base$side == "R")
  mL <- max(1L, floor(rho * length(iL)))
  mR <- max(1L, floor(rho * length(iR)))
  c(sample(iL, mL, replace = TRUE), sample(iR, mR, replace = TRUE))
}

# ---------- outcome-blind thinning within one stratum level ----------
# Goal: for each side, expected retained events ≈ E_star
# Robust handling: if prevalence is 0/NaN -> q=1 (no thinning needed)
thin_idx_stratum <- function(idx, base, level, E_star = 160) {
  # restrict to stratum
  ii <- idx[base$g[idx] == level]
  if (!length(ii)) return(ii)

  side <- base$side[ii]
  y    <- base$y[ii]

  # side stats
  NsL <- sum(side == "L"); NsR <- sum(side == "R")
  pL  <- mean(y[side == "L"], na.rm = TRUE)
  pR  <- mean(y[side == "R"], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.nan(pL)) pL <- 0
  if (is.nan(pR)) pR <- 0

  # thinning probabilities
  qL <- if (pL <= 0) 1 else min(1, E_star / max(1, NsL * pL))
  qR <- if (pR <= 0) 1 else min(1, E_star / max(1, NsR * pR))

  u <- runif(length(ii))
  keep <- (side == "L" & u < qL) | (side == "R" & u < qR)
  out <- ii[keep]

  # guard: if thinning wiped a side, fall back to no thinning for this stratum
  if (!(any(base$side[out] == "L") && any(base$side[out] == "R"))) ii else out
}

# ---------- local counts inside |x| <= h_star by side ----------
local_counts_ok_idx <- function(ii, base, h_star, n_min_per_side) {
  if (!length(ii)) return(FALSE)
  win <- ii[abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star]
  if (!length(win)) return(FALSE)
  tab <- table(base$side[win])
  all(c("L", "R") %in% names(tab)) && min(as.integer(tab)) >= n_min_per_side
}

# ---------- rdrobust wrappers ----------
fit_rd_outcome_idx <- function(ii, base, h_star) {
  d <- base[ii, , drop = FALSE]

  fit <- tryCatch({
    rdrobust(
      y = d$y, x = d$x, fuzzy = d$hz,
      c = 0, p = 1, kernel = "triangular", masspoints = "adjust",
      h = h_star
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    list(tau = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, tau_rel = NA_real_)
  } else {
    # relative effect exactly as in subtype code
    # NOTE: beta_Y_p_l[1] may be 0 or NA in degenerate cases; guard division
    denom <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$beta_Y_p_l[1]))
    tau   <- unname(fit$coef[1])
    se    <- unname(fit$se[3])
    tau_rel <- if (is.finite(denom) && denom != 0) unname(tau / denom) else NA_real_
    list(tau = tau, se = se, tau_rel = tau_rel)
  }
}

fit_first_stage_base <- function(idx, base, h_star) {
  d <- base[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  fs <- tryCatch({
    rdrobust(
      y = d$hz, x = d$x,
      c = 0, p = 1, kernel = "triangular", masspoints = "adjust",
      h = h_star
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fs)) return(list(tau_fs = NA_real_, se_fs = NA_real_))
  list(tau_fs = unname(fs$coef[1]), se_fs = unname(fs$se[3]))
}

fit_first_stage_idx <- function(ii, base, h_star) {
  d <- base[ii, , drop = FALSE]
  fs <- tryCatch({
    rdrobust(
      y = d$hz, x = d$x,
      c = 0, p = 1, kernel = "triangular", masspoints = "adjust",
      h = h_star
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fs)) return(list(tau_fs = NA_real_, se_fs = NA_real_))
  list(tau_fs = unname(fs$coef[1]), se_fs = unname(fs$se[3]))
}

# ---------- one iteration: redraw QC + cached thinning ----------
boot_once_gender <- function(base, strata_levels, ref_level,
                             E_star = 160, rho = 0.95,
                             h_star,
                             n_min_per_side = 1000,
                             tau_fs_min = 0.10,
                             max_redraw = 50L,
                             cutoff = 0) {

  redraws <- 0L
  qc_flag <- NA_character_

  # store cached thinned indices if QC passes
  thinned_by_lv <- NULL
  fs_base <- NULL

  repeat {
    redraws <- redraws + 1L

    # bail out (rare): proceed without QC, but still return something
    if (redraws > max_redraw) {
      qc_flag <- "max_redraw"
      idx <- resample_idx_by_side(base, rho = rho)
      thinned_by_lv <- lapply(strata_levels, function(lv) thin_idx_stratum(idx, base, lv, E_star))
      names(thinned_by_lv) <- strata_levels
      fs_base <- fit_first_stage_base(idx, base, h_star)
      break
    }

    # 1) base resample (outcome-blind)
    idx <- resample_idx_by_side(base, rho = rho)

    # 2) base first-stage strength check (cheap: 1 rdrobust per redraw)
    fs_base <- fit_first_stage_base(idx, base, h_star)
    if (!is.finite(fs_base$tau_fs) || abs(fs_base$tau_fs) < tau_fs_min) {
      qc_flag <- "weak_first_stage_base"
      next
    }

    # 3) per-stratum thinning + local-n checks (no rdrobust here)
    qc_fail <- FALSE
    thinned_by_lv <- vector("list", length(strata_levels))
    names(thinned_by_lv) <- strata_levels

    for (lv in strata_levels) {
      ii <- thin_idx_stratum(idx, base, lv, E_star = E_star)
      thinned_by_lv[[lv]] <- ii
      if (!local_counts_ok_idx(ii, base, h_star, n_min_per_side)) {
        qc_flag <- paste0("local_n_fail_", lv)
        qc_fail <- TRUE
        break
      }
    }

    if (!qc_fail) { qc_flag <- NA_character_; break }
  }

  # fit outcome + (optional) stratum-specific FS for diagnostics
  fits <- lapply(strata_levels, function(lv) {
    ii <- thinned_by_lv[[lv]]

    fr <- fit_rd_outcome_idx(ii, base, h_star)
    fs <- fit_first_stage_idx(ii, base, h_star)

    nL <- sum(base$side[ii] == "L" & abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star)
    nR <- sum(base$side[ii] == "R" & abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star)

    tibble(
      level = lv,
      tau = fr$tau,
      se  = fr$se,
      tau_rel = fr$tau_rel,
      tau_fs  = fs$tau_fs,
      se_fs   = fs$se_fs,
      nL_win  = nL,
      nR_win  = nR,
      redraws = redraws,
      qc_flag = qc_flag,
      tau_fs_base = fs_base$tau_fs
    )
  }) |> bind_rows()

  # paired contrasts vs reference within same resample
  tau_ref     <- fits$tau[fits$level == ref_level]
  se_ref      <- fits$se [fits$level == ref_level]
  tau_rel_ref <- fits$tau_rel[fits$level == ref_level]

  fits %>%
    mutate(
      delta_vs_ref     = tau - tau_ref,
      se_ref           = se_ref,
      delta_rel_vs_ref = tau_rel - tau_rel_ref
    )
}

# ---------- main runner ----------
run_boot_gender <- function(dat, id_var, strata_var,
                            strata_levels, ref_level,
                            B = 3000,
                            E_star = 160, rho = 0.90, cutoff = 0,
                            h_star,
                            n_min_per_side = 1000,
                            tau_fs_min = 0.10,
                            max_redraw = 50L,
                            seed = 123,
                            progress_every = 50L) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # precompute base once (big speed win)
  base <- prepare_base_gender(dat, id_var = id_var, strata_var = strata_var, cutoff = cutoff)

  out <- vector("list", B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    out[[b]] <- boot_once_gender(
      base = base,
      strata_levels = strata_levels,
      ref_level = ref_level,
      E_star = E_star, rho = rho,
      h_star = h_star,
      n_min_per_side = n_min_per_side,
      tau_fs_min = tau_fs_min,
      max_redraw = max_redraw,
      cutoff = cutoff
    ) %>% mutate(iteration = b)

    if (progress_every > 0L && (b %% progress_every == 0L)) {
      message(sprintf("%s - iter %d/%d", Sys.time(), b, B))
    }
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

# ==========================================================
# RUN: GENDER
# ==========================================================

gender_levels <- c("F", "M")
ref_gender    <- "M"

boot_gender <- run_boot_gender(
  dat = data_main_p,
  id_var = "new_enc_nhi",
  strata_var = "GENDER",
  strata_levels = gender_levels,
  ref_level = ref_gender,
  B = 1500,
  E_star = 160,
  rho = 0.90,
  cutoff = 0,
  h_star = 1508.783,
  n_min_per_side = 1000,
  tau_fs_min = 0.10,
  max_redraw = 50L,
  seed = 123,
  progress_every = 5
)

# ==========================================================
# Summaries: primary, sensitivity, and relative-scale contrasts
# ==========================================================

# Primary: absolute-scale paired contrast (F - M)
gender_primary <- boot_gender %>%
  filter(level != ref_gender, is.finite(delta_vs_ref)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_delta  = median(delta_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided = 2 * pmin(mean(delta_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(delta_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Secondary: SE-based weighted summaries (absolute scale)
gender_sensitivity <- boot_gender %>%
  filter(level != ref_gender, is.finite(delta_vs_ref), is.finite(se), is.finite(se_ref)) %>%
  mutate(w = 1 / pmax(1e-12, se^2 + se_ref^2)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_w = sum(w * delta_vs_ref) / sum(w),
    lo_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.025),
    hi_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.975),
    p_w   = { wpos <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref >= 0]); wneg <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref <= 0]);
    2 * min(wpos, wneg) / (wpos + wneg) },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Relative-scale paired contrast
gender_primary_rel <- boot_gender %>%
  filter(level != ref_gender, is.finite(delta_rel_vs_ref)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_delta_rel  = median(delta_rel_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta_rel   = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta_rel   = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided_rel = 2 * pmin(mean(delta_rel_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                              mean(delta_rel_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(gender_primary)
print(gender_sensitivity)
print(gender_primary_rel)

saveRDS(boot_gender, file.path(processed_df_dir, "boot_gender.RDS"))
saveRDS(gender_primary, file.path(processed_df_dir, "gender_primary.RDS"))
saveRDS(gender_sensitivity, file.path(processed_df_dir, "gender_sensitivity.RDS"))

# Primary: absolute-scale paired contrast (F - M)
dep_primary <- boot_dep %>%
  filter(level != ref_dep, is.finite(delta_vs_ref)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_delta  = median(delta_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided = 2 * pmin(mean(delta_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(delta_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Secondary: SE-based weighted summaries (absolute scale)
dep_sensitivity <- boot_dep %>%
  filter(level != ref_dep, is.finite(delta_vs_ref), is.finite(se), is.finite(se_ref)) %>%
  mutate(w = 1 / pmax(1e-12, se^2 + se_ref^2)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_w = sum(w * delta_vs_ref) / sum(w),
    lo_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.025),
    hi_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.975),
    p_w   = { wpos <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref >= 0]); wneg <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref <= 0]);
    2 * min(wpos, wneg) / (wpos + wneg) },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Relative-scale paired contrast
dep_primary_rel <- boot_dep %>%
  filter(level != ref_dep, is.finite(delta_rel_vs_ref)) %>%
  group_by(level) %>%
  summarise(
    est_delta_rel  = median(delta_rel_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta_rel   = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta_rel   = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided_rel = 2 * pmin(mean(delta_rel_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                              mean(delta_rel_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(dep_primary)
print(dep_sensitivity)
print(dep_primary_rel)

saveRDS(boot_dep, file.path(processed_df_dir, "boot_dep.RDS"))
saveRDS(dep_primary, file.path(processed_df_dir, "dep_primary.RDS"))
saveRDS(dep_sensitivity, file.path(processed_df_dir, "dep_sensitivity.RDS"))
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = TRUE, eval = run_bootstraps}
# ===============================
# Heterogeneity bootstrap by dementia subtype
# ===============================

# --- SETTINGS ---
n_iter   <- 3000
cutoff   <- 0
E_star   <- 160
rho      <- 0.92
h_star   <- 1508.783
n_min_per_side <- 800
tau_fs_min     <- 0.08
max_redraw     <- 500

# optional: save partial progress every N iterations
save_every <- 100
out_dir <- processed_df_dir

# --- SUBTYPES ---
dementia_outcomes <- c(
  "alzheimers",
  "vascular_dementia",
  "unspecified_dementia",
  "other_dementia_2"
)
ref_outcome <- "alzheimers"

# --- UTILS ---
wtd_quantile <- function(x, w, probs) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[ok]
  w <- w[ok]
  if (!length(x) || sum(w) <= 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(probs)))
  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]
  w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  sapply(probs, function(p) x[which.max(cw >= p)])
}

# -------------------------------
# Prepare minimal base once
# -------------------------------
prepare_base_subtypes <- function(dat, id_var, cutoff = 0) {
  stopifnot(id_var %in% names(dat))
  stopifnot(all(c("running_var_days", "hz_vacc") %in% names(dat)))

  tibble::tibble(
    id   = dat[[id_var]],
    x    = as.numeric(dat$running_var_days),
    side = ifelse(as.numeric(dat$running_var_days) < cutoff, "L", "R"),
    hz   = as.numeric(dat$hz_vacc)
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# Common m-out-of-n resample by side
# -------------------------------
resample_idx_by_side <- function(base, rho = 0.95) {
  iL <- which(base$side == "L")
  iR <- which(base$side == "R")

  if (!length(iL) || !length(iR)) {
    return(integer(0))
  }

  mL <- max(1L, floor(rho * length(iL)))
  mR <- max(1L, floor(rho * length(iR)))

  c(
    sample(iL, mL, replace = TRUE),
    sample(iR, mR, replace = TRUE)
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# Subtype-specific thinning inside common resample
# -------------------------------
thin_idx_on_base <- function(idx, base, y_vec, E_star = 160) {
  if (!length(idx)) return(integer(0))

  d <- tibble::tibble(
    idx  = idx,
    side = base$side[idx],
    y    = y_vec[idx]
  )

  prev <- d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(side) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Ns  = dplyr::n(),
      pks = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pks = ifelse(is.nan(pks) | !is.finite(pks), 0, pks),
      q   = ifelse(pks <= 0, 1, pmin(1, E_star / pmax(1, Ns * pks)))
    )

  d <- d %>% dplyr::left_join(prev, by = "side")

  if (any(!is.finite(d$q))) {
    d$q[!is.finite(d$q)] <- 1
  }

  keep <- stats::rbinom(nrow(d), 1, d$q) == 1
  out <- d$idx[keep]

  # fallback: if thinning wipes a side, revert to unthinned resample
  out_sides <- unique(base$side[out])
  if (!all(c("L", "R") %in% out_sides)) {
    return(idx)
  }

  out
}

# -------------------------------
# Local counts inside |x| <= h_star
# -------------------------------
local_counts_ok_idx <- function(ii, base, h_star, n_min_per_side) {
  if (!length(ii)) return(FALSE)

  win <- ii[abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star]
  if (!length(win)) return(FALSE)

  tab <- table(base$side[win])
  all(c("L", "R") %in% names(tab)) &&
    min(as.integer(tab[c("L", "R")])) >= n_min_per_side
}

# -------------------------------
# RD wrappers
# -------------------------------
fit_rd_outcome_idx <- function(ii, base, y_vec, h_star) {
  if (!length(ii)) {
    return(list(tau = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, tau_rel = NA_real_))
  }

  d <- tibble::tibble(
    y  = as.numeric(y_vec[ii]),
    x  = as.numeric(base$x[ii]),
    hz = as.numeric(base$hz[ii])
  )

  fit <- tryCatch({
    rdrobust(
      y = d$y,
      x = d$x,
      fuzzy = d$hz,
      c = 0,
      p = 1,
      kernel = "triangular",
      masspoints = "adjust",
      h = h_star
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(list(tau = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, tau_rel = NA_real_))
  }

  tau <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$coef[1]))
  se  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$se[3]))
  denom <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$beta_Y_p_l[1]))

  tau_rel <- if (is.finite(denom) && denom != 0 && is.finite(tau)) tau / denom else NA_real_

  list(
    tau = tau,
    se = se,
    tau_rel = tau_rel
  )
}

fit_first_stage_idx <- function(ii, base, h_star) {
  if (!length(ii)) {
    return(list(tau_fs = NA_real_, se_fs = NA_real_))
  }

  d <- tibble::tibble(
    hz = as.numeric(base$hz[ii]),
    x  = as.numeric(base$x[ii])
  )

  fs <- tryCatch({
    rdrobust(
      y = d$hz,
      x = d$x,
      c = 0,
      p = 1,
      kernel = "triangular",
      masspoints = "adjust",
      h = h_star
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fs)) {
    return(list(tau_fs = NA_real_, se_fs = NA_real_))
  }

  list(
    tau_fs = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fs$coef[1])),
    se_fs  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fs$se[3]))
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# One iteration with redraw QC
# -------------------------------
boot_once_all <- function(
    base,
    y_list,
    outcomes,
    ref_outcome,
    E_star,
    rho,
    h_star,
    n_min_per_side,
    tau_fs_min,
    max_redraw = 30L,
    verbose = FALSE
) {
  redraws <- 0L
  qc_flag <- NA_character_
  idx_base <- integer(0)
  idx_by_outcome <- NULL

  repeat {
    redraws <- redraws + 1L

    if (redraws > max_redraw) {
      qc_flag <- "max_redraw"
      idx_base <- resample_idx_by_side(base, rho = rho)

      idx_by_outcome <- lapply(outcomes, function(outc) {
        thin_idx_on_base(idx_base, base, y_list[[outc]], E_star = E_star)
      })
      names(idx_by_outcome) <- outcomes
      break
    }

    idx_base <- resample_idx_by_side(base, rho = rho)
    if (!length(idx_base)) {
      qc_flag <- "empty_base_resample"
      next
    }

    qc_fail <- FALSE
    idx_by_outcome <- vector("list", length(outcomes))
    names(idx_by_outcome) <- outcomes

    for (outc in outcomes) {
      ii <- thin_idx_on_base(idx_base, base, y_list[[outc]], E_star = E_star)
      idx_by_outcome[[outc]] <- ii

      if (!local_counts_ok_idx(ii, base, h_star, n_min_per_side)) {
        qc_flag <- paste0("local_n_fail_", outc)
        qc_fail <- TRUE
        break
      }

      fs <- fit_first_stage_idx(ii, base, h_star)
      if (!is.finite(fs$tau_fs) || abs(fs$tau_fs) < tau_fs_min) {
        qc_flag <- paste0("weak_first_stage_", outc)
        qc_fail <- TRUE
        break
      }
    }

    if (!qc_fail) {
      qc_flag <- NA_character_
      break
    }

    if (verbose && redraws %% 25L == 0L) {
      message("Redraw ", redraws, ": ", qc_flag)
    }
  }

  fits <- lapply(outcomes, function(outc) {
    ii <- idx_by_outcome[[outc]]

    fr <- fit_rd_outcome_idx(ii, base, y_list[[outc]], h_star)
    fs <- fit_first_stage_idx(ii, base, h_star)

    nL <- sum(base$side[ii] == "L" & abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star, na.rm = TRUE)
    nR <- sum(base$side[ii] == "R" & abs(base$x[ii]) <= h_star, na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble::tibble(
      outcome = outc,
      tau = fr$tau,
      se = fr$se,
      tau_rel = fr$tau_rel,
      tau_fs = fs$tau_fs,
      se_fs = fs$se_fs,
      nL_win = nL,
      nR_win = nR,
      redraws = redraws,
      qc_flag = qc_flag
    )
  }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

  tau_ref <- fits$tau[fits$outcome == ref_outcome]
  se_ref  <- fits$se[fits$outcome == ref_outcome]
  tau_rel_ref <- fits$tau_rel[fits$outcome == ref_outcome]

  if (length(tau_ref) != 1) tau_ref <- NA_real_
  if (length(se_ref) != 1) se_ref <- NA_real_
  if (length(tau_rel_ref) != 1) tau_rel_ref <- NA_real_

  fits %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      delta_vs_ref = tau - tau_ref,
      se_ref = se_ref,
      delta_rel_vs_ref = tau_rel - tau_rel_ref
    )
}

# -------------------------------
# Main runner
# -------------------------------
run_boot_subtypes <- function(
    dat,
    id_var,
    outcomes,
    ref_outcome,
    B = 3000,
    E_star = 160,
    rho = 0.92,
    cutoff = 0,
    h_star,
    n_min_per_side = 800,
    tau_fs_min = 0.08,
    max_redraw = 500L,
    seed = 123,
    progress_every = 50L,
    save_every = 0L,
    save_path = NULL
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  stopifnot(id_var %in% names(dat))
  stopifnot(all(outcomes %in% names(dat)))
  stopifnot(ref_outcome %in% outcomes)

  base <- prepare_base_subtypes(dat, id_var = id_var, cutoff = cutoff)

  y_list <- lapply(outcomes, function(v) as.numeric(dat[[v]]))
  names(y_list) <- outcomes

  out <- vector("list", B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    out[[b]] <- boot_once_all(
      base = base,
      y_list = y_list,
      outcomes = outcomes,
      ref_outcome = ref_outcome,
      E_star = E_star,
      rho = rho,
      h_star = h_star,
      n_min_per_side = n_min_per_side,
      tau_fs_min = tau_fs_min,
      max_redraw = max_redraw,
      verbose = FALSE
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(iteration = b)

    if (progress_every > 0L && b %% progress_every == 0L) {
      message(sprintf("%s — iteration %d/%d", Sys.time(), b, B))
    }

    if (!is.null(save_path) && save_every > 0L && b %% save_every == 0L) {
      tmp <- dplyr::bind_rows(out[seq_len(b)])
      saveRDS(tmp, save_path)
      gc()
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# -------------------------------
# RUN
# -------------------------------
results_df <- run_boot_subtypes(
  dat = data_main_p,
  id_var = "new_enc_nhi",
  outcomes = dementia_outcomes,
  ref_outcome = ref_outcome,
  B = n_iter,
  E_star = E_star,
  rho = rho,
  cutoff = cutoff,
  h_star = h_star,
  n_min_per_side = n_min_per_side,
  tau_fs_min = tau_fs_min,
  max_redraw = max_redraw,
  seed = 123,
  progress_every = 10L,
  save_every = save_every,
  save_path = file.path(out_dir, "data_hte_type_of_dementia_partial.RDS")
)

# --- SAVE RAW ---
saveRDS(results_df, file.path(out_dir, "data_hte_type_of_dementia.RDS"))
data_hte_type_of_dementia <- results_df

# -------------------------------
# PRIMARY HETEROGENEITY
# -------------------------------
paired_df <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    outcome != ref_outcome,
    is.finite(delta_vs_ref)
  )

hetero_summary <- paired_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(outcome) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    est_delta  = median(delta_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta   = quantile(delta_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided = 2 * pmin(
      mean(delta_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(delta_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(hetero_summary)

# -------------------------------
# SECONDARY SENSITIVITY
# -------------------------------
sens_df <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    outcome != ref_outcome,
    is.finite(delta_vs_ref),
    is.finite(se),
    is.finite(se_ref)
  )

sens_summary <- sens_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(w = 1 / pmax(1e-12, se^2 + se_ref^2)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(outcome) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    est_w = sum(w * delta_vs_ref) / sum(w),
    lo_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.025),
    hi_w  = wtd_quantile(delta_vs_ref, w, 0.975),
    p_w   = {
      wpos <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref >= 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      wneg <- sum(w[delta_vs_ref <= 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      2 * min(wpos, wneg) / (wpos + wneg)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(sens_summary)

# -------------------------------
# OPTIONAL: relative-scale contrasts
# -------------------------------
paired_rel <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    outcome != ref_outcome,
    is.finite(delta_rel_vs_ref)
  )

hetero_re_summary <- paired_rel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(outcome) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    est_delta_rel = median(delta_rel_vs_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_delta_rel  = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_delta_rel  = quantile(delta_rel_vs_ref, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_twosided    = 2 * pmin(
      mean(delta_rel_vs_ref >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(delta_rel_vs_ref <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(hetero_re_summary)

saveRDS(hetero_summary,    file.path(out_dir, "hetero_summary.RDS"))
saveRDS(sens_summary,      file.path(out_dir, "sens_summary.RDS"))
saveRDS(hetero_re_summary, file.path(out_dir, "hetero_re_summary.RDS"))
```

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 15, out.width = "100%"}
# Dementia types
if (!exists("data_hte_type_of_dementia", inherits = FALSE)) {
  data_hte_type_of_dementia <- readRDS(
    file.path(out_dir, "data_hte_type_of_dementia.RDS")
  )
}

boot_type <- data_hte_type_of_dementia %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_lab = recode(
      outcome,
      alzheimers = "Alzheimer's dementia",
      vascular_dementia = "Vascular dementia",
      unspecified_dementia = "Unspecified dementia",
      other_dementia_2 = "Pick's and Parkinson's dementia"
    ),
    tau_pp   = tau * 100,
    tau_relp = tau_rel * 100
  )


ref_outcome <- "alzheimers"


get_boot_p <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  2 * min(mean(x <= 0), mean(x >= 0))
}


make_density_panel <- function(data, comp_outcome,
                               x_limits = c(-8, 8),
                               x_breaks = seq(-8, 8, by = 2)) {

  plot_df <- data %>%
    filter(outcome %in% c(ref_outcome, comp_outcome)) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        outcome_lab,
        levels = c("Alzheimer's dementia",
                   setdiff(unique(outcome_lab), "Alzheimer's dementia"))
      )
    )

  comp_lab <- plot_df %>%
    filter(outcome == comp_outcome) %>%
    distinct(outcome_lab) %>%
    pull(outcome_lab)


  med_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      median_tau     = median(tau_pp, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_tau_rel = median(tau_relp, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lab = paste0(
        "Medians:\n",
        sprintf("%.2f", median_tau), " abs. (p.p.)\n",
        sprintf("%.2f", median_tau_rel), " rel. (%)"
      )
    )


  pval <- data %>%
    filter(outcome == comp_outcome) %>%
    summarise(p = get_boot_p(delta_vs_ref)) %>%
    pull(p)

  ad_median <- med_df %>%
    filter(group == "Alzheimer's dementia") %>%
    pull(median_tau)

  comp_median <- med_df %>%
    filter(group != "Alzheimer's dementia") %>%
    pull(median_tau)

  if (ad_median > comp_median) {
    med_df <- med_df %>%
      mutate(hjust_val = ifelse(group == "Alzheimer's dementia", -0.05, 1.05))
  } else {
    med_df <- med_df %>%
      mutate(hjust_val = ifelse(group == "Alzheimer's dementia", 1.05, -0.05))
  }

  cols <- c("#D81B60", "#1E88E5")
  names(cols) <- c("Alzheimer's dementia", comp_lab)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = tau_pp, fill = group, colour = group)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9, adjust = 1) +
    geom_vline(
      data = med_df,
      aes(xintercept = median_tau, colour = group),
      linewidth = 0.9,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = med_df,
      aes(
        x = median_tau,
        y = Inf,
        label = lab,
        colour = group
      ),
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.25,
      label.r = unit(0, "lines"),
      vjust = 1.4,
      hjust = med_df$hjust_val,
      size = 3.4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", pval)),
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15,
      size = 3.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = x_limits,
      breaks = x_breaks,
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Alzheimer's dementia vs", comp_lab),
      x = "Effect of HZ vaccination receipt (% points)",
      y = "Density",
      fill = NULL,
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 1))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.length.x = unit(3, "pt"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}


p_vasc <- make_density_panel(boot_type, "vascular_dementia")
p_uns  <- make_density_panel(boot_type, "unspecified_dementia")
p_oth  <- make_density_panel(boot_type, "other_dementia_2")


g.dt <- arrangeGrob(
  p_vasc, p_uns, p_oth,
  ncol = 2
)


grid.draw(g.dt)

)
```
